title: Load test: matching API with 250 students
text:
Daniel Ortiz runs the load test on staging after the performance fix in pairly-api.

Goal: matching API response time under 1 second (p95) with 250 students matching at once. Today it is around 4 seconds.

Command: npm run loadtest -- --students 250
Attendees: Daniel Ortiz, Sam Okafor, Wop testwell.
If it passes, mark the item as done on the "Beta launch checklist - Nov 2" page.
